descriptions.zh-CN: {{app_name}} 高级 CLI 启动与派发：WSL、resume、PTY 恢复、TaskBinding、REST 兜底及跨 CLI worker 诊断。
descriptions.en: Advanced {{app_name}} CLI launch and dispatch: WSL, resume, PTY recovery, TaskBinding, REST fallback, and cross-CLI worker diagnostics.

descriptions.zh-CN: 把一个持久任务派给任意已注册的 {{app_name}} CLI，用于跨 CLI 交接、实现、评审、调研或恢复。
descriptions.en: Dispatch a durable task to any registered {{app_name}} CLI. Use for cross-CLI handoff, implementation, review, research, or resume workflows.

descriptions.zh-CN: 在 {{app_name}} 里启动或重启项目的 dev/build 进程，先解决端口和 PID 冲突；支持 local / WSL / SSH。
descriptions.en: Launch or restart a project's dev/build process in {{app_name}}, resolving port and PID conflicts first. Supports local, WSL, and SSH runtimes.

descriptions.zh-CN: 总结当前对话上下文，在同一项目里派一个新的兼容 CLI 会话沿分支方向继续；只继承压缩摘要，不带完整记录。
descriptions.en: Summarize the current conversation and dispatch a new compatible CLI session in the same project to continue down a branch. Inherits a compressed summary, not the full transcript.

descriptions.zh-CN: 把大任务拆成独立子任务，并行派发多个 CLI 会话；适合安全的跨项目扇出。
descriptions.en: Split a large task into independent subtasks and dispatch parallel CLI sessions. Use for safe cross-project fan-out.

descriptions.zh-CN: 同一项目内的高级并行编排：原生子 agent 加隔离的 {{app_name}} worker；适合可拆成独立子任务的工作。
descriptions.en: Advanced same-project parallel orchestration with native sub-agents and isolated {{app_name}} workers. Use when work can split into independent subtasks.

descriptions.zh-CN: 设计并运行 {{app_name}} 的 Commander / Leader / Worker 多 agent 团队；增删改角色前必须先问用户。
descriptions.en: Design and run a {{app_name}} Commander/Leader/Worker team for multi-agent execution. Always ask before adding, removing, or changing roles.

descriptions.zh-CN: 通过 MCP 管理 {{app_name}} 工作空间：列出、新建、加项目、归档、修路径、批量导入仓库；永久删除只能在 UI 里做。
descriptions.en: Manage {{app_name}} workspaces via MCP: list, create, add projects, archive, fix paths, bulk-import repos. Permanent deletion is UI-only.

descriptions.zh-CN: 诊断 {{app_name}} 工作空间存储：workspace.json、projects.csv、数据目录路由、遗留文件；只读排查，不直接改。
descriptions.en: Diagnose {{app_name}} workspace storage: workspace.json, projects.csv, data-dir routing, legacy files. Read-only triage; changes go through MCP or the UI.

descriptions.zh-CN: 在不丢数据的前提下审计并整理 {{app_name}} 工作空间目录，先给出可审阅的计划；不确定的文件只移入 _trash/。
descriptions.en: Audit and tidy {{app_name}} workspace folders without data loss, producing a reviewable plan first. Uncertain files go to _trash/, never deleted.

descriptions.zh-CN: 引导用户使用 {{app_name}} 内置的「迁移工作空间」流程（本地到本地，或本地到 WSL）；只给操作指引，不直接执行。
descriptions.en: Guide the user through {{app_name}}'s built-in Migrate Workspace flow (local to local, or local to WSL). Guidance only; it does not run the migration.

descriptions.zh-CN: 查看 {{app_name}} 实时会话：列出标签、读最近输出、查启动记录或历史 Claude 会话；要恢复会话请转 launch-task。
descriptions.en: Inspect live {{app_name}} sessions: list tabs, read recent output, look up launches or past Claude history. To resume a session, use launch-task.

descriptions.zh-CN: 把待办按族群聚类，每组派给一个新的 CLI 会话；用于跑完整个 backlog。
descriptions.en: Cluster pending todos by family and dispatch each group to a fresh CLI session. Use when asked to run the backlog.

descriptions.zh-CN: 用外部 spec-workflow MCP 跑规格驱动流程（需求 → 设计 → 任务）；未安装该 MCP 时请改用 built-in-spec。
descriptions.en: Run a spec-driven workflow (requirements to design to tasks) with the external spec-workflow MCP. If it is not installed, use built-in-spec.

descriptions.zh-CN: {{app_name}} 内置 Spec 与 Todo 双向绑定：文件布局、specService API、Tauri 命令边界；不是 MCP 工作流。
descriptions.en: {{app_name}} built-in Spec plus Todo two-way binding: file layout, specService API, Tauri command boundary. Not an MCP workflow.

descriptions.zh-CN: 按 {{app_name}} 的 OpenSpec 方法：动手前先写 Proposal、Design 和 Tasks；不依赖外部 spec-workflow MCP。
descriptions.en: Follow the {{app_name}} OpenSpec-style method: write Proposal, Design, and Tasks before implementing. No external spec-workflow MCP needed.

descriptions.zh-CN: 把写好的计划交给 Codex worker 实现，带 leader / worker 注册与自动反馈；Claude 只规划不写代码。WSL 入口见 plan2codexwsl。
descriptions.en: Hand a finished plan to a Codex worker to implement, with leader/worker registration and auto-feedback. Claude plans, Codex codes. For WSL see plan2codexwsl.

descriptions.zh-CN: 把写好的计划交给另一个 Claude Code 实例实现，带 leader / worker 自动反馈；流程同 plantocodex，只写 Claude worker 的差异。
descriptions.en: Hand a finished plan to another Claude Code instance to implement, with leader/worker auto-feedback. Same flow as plantocodex; covers Claude-worker differences only.

descriptions.zh-CN: 在 plan mode 内启动另一个兼容 CLI（本地或 WSL）做同行评审；用于高风险 plan 二审或用户要求跨 CLI peer review。
descriptions.en: From plan mode, launch another compatible CLI (local or WSL) for peer review. Use for high-risk plans or when the user asks for a cross-CLI review.

descriptions.zh-CN: 在 WSL 里用 Codex 执行计划：已注册路径、runtimeKind 和 WSL 路径转换；是 plantocodex 的 WSL 特化入口。
descriptions.en: Run a plan with Codex inside WSL: registered paths, runtimeKind, and WSL path translation. The WSL-specific entry point for plantocodex.

descriptions.zh-CN: 把写好的计划交给 Grok CLI 实例实现，带 leader / worker 自动反馈；流程同 plantocodex，只写 Grok worker 的差异。
descriptions.en: Hand a finished plan to a Grok CLI instance to implement, with leader/worker auto-feedback. Same flow as plantocodex; covers Grok-worker differences only.

descriptions.zh-CN: 找出并安全清理僵尸开发进程，同时保护正在运行的 {{app_name}}、MCP 和 dev server。
descriptions.en: Find and safely kill zombie dev processes while protecting active {{app_name}}, MCP, and dev servers.

descriptions.zh-CN: 交接前收尾：看 diff、跑检查、核对文档和测试、总结改动；作为 worker 时一并完成 {{app_name}} 上报。
descriptions.en: Finalize a task before handoff: inspect the diff, run checks, verify docs and tests, summarize changes. As a worker, also report back to {{app_name}}.

descriptions.zh-CN: 评审横跨 UI、store、IPC/API、后端服务、仓储与持久化的改动；多层改动后或怀疑层间契约不一致时使用。
descriptions.en: Review changes spanning UI, stores, IPC/API, backend services, repositories, and persistence. Use after multi-layer changes or suspected contract drift.

descriptions.zh-CN: 把长期记忆同步写入 {{app_name}} 共享池，让 Claude 和 Codex 共用一份记忆；CC_PANES_* 环境变量全缺失时必须跳过。
descriptions.en: Mirror long-term memory into the {{app_name}} shared pool so Claude and Codex share one memory. Skip when all CC_PANES_* env vars are missing.

descriptions.zh-CN: 从 {{app_name}} 历史里找回当前项目或工作空间过去的计划；缺少 CC_PANES_PROJECT_PATH 时跳过。
descriptions.en: Recall past plans for the current project or workspace from {{app_name}} history. Skip when CC_PANES_PROJECT_PATH is missing.

descriptions.zh-CN: 完成一轮实质性工作后推送带摘要的通知（桌面加 IM）；琐碎问答不要用。
descriptions.en: Push a rich summary notification (desktop plus IM) after finishing a substantial turn. Not for trivial Q&A.

descriptions.zh-CN: {{app_name}} core MCP 用法：派发、会话读写、等待、通知、记忆、待办、AI 面板。工具描述很短，细节都在这里。
descriptions.en: How to use the {{app_name}} core MCP tools well: dispatch, session I/O, waiting, notifications, memory, todos, AI panels. Tool descriptions are terse; the details live here.

descriptions.zh-CN: 用 cc-panes-ctl 从会话里管理 {{app_name}}：工作空间、项目、启动档、共享 MCP、runner、媒体、浏览器、文件。
descriptions.en: Manage {{app_name}} itself from a session via cc-panes-ctl: workspaces, projects, launch profiles, shared MCP, runners, media, browser tabs, files.

descriptions.zh-CN: 把工作从 {{app_name}} 交接到 Cursor IDE：打开项目 / worktree、写交接文件、可选 prompt 深链、派发 Cursor Agent CLI，或用 cursor_bridge 做受限会话。
descriptions.en: Hand off work from {{app_name}} to Cursor IDE: open the project/worktree, write a handoff file, optional prompt deeplink, dispatch Cursor Agent CLI, or use cursor_bridge for bounded sessions.
